verses.text: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever.
lines: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good;
for his loving kindness endures forever.

verses.text: Give thanks to the God of gods; for his loving kindness endures forever.
lines: Give thanks to the God of gods;
for his loving kindness endures forever.

verses.text: Give thanks to the Lord of lords; for his loving kindness endures forever:
lines: Give thanks to the Lord of lords;
for his loving kindness endures forever:

verses.text: to him who alone does great wonders; for his loving kindness endures forever:
lines: to him who alone does great wonders;
for his loving kindness endures forever:

verses.text: to him who by understanding made the heavens; for his loving kindness endures forever:
lines: to him who by understanding made the heavens;
for his loving kindness endures forever:

verses.text: to him who spread out the earth above the waters; for his loving kindness endures forever:
lines: to him who spread out the earth above the waters;
for his loving kindness endures forever:

verses.text: to him who made the great lights; for his loving kindness endures forever:
lines: to him who made the great lights;
for his loving kindness endures forever:

verses.text: the sun to rule by day; for his loving kindness endures forever;
lines: the sun to rule by day;
for his loving kindness endures forever;

verses.text: the moon and stars to rule by night; for his loving kindness endures forever:
lines: the moon and stars to rule by night;
for his loving kindness endures forever:

verses.text: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn; for his loving kindness endures forever;
lines: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn;
for his loving kindness endures forever;

verses.text: and brought out Israel from among them; for his loving kindness endures forever;
lines: and brought out Israel from among them;
for his loving kindness endures forever;

verses.text: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm; for his loving kindness endures forever:
lines: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm;
for his loving kindness endures forever:

verses.text: to him who divided the Red Sea apart; for his loving kindness endures forever;
lines: to him who divided the Red Sea apart;
for his loving kindness endures forever;

verses.text: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it; for his loving kindness endures forever;
lines: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it;
for his loving kindness endures forever;

verses.text: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea; for his loving kindness endures forever:
lines: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea;
for his loving kindness endures forever:

verses.text: to him who led his people through the wilderness; for his loving kindness endures forever:
lines: to him who led his people through the wilderness;
for his loving kindness endures forever:

verses.text: to him who struck great kings; for his loving kindness endures forever;
lines: to him who struck great kings;
for his loving kindness endures forever;

verses.text: and killed mighty kings; for his loving kindness endures forever:
lines: and killed mighty kings;
for his loving kindness endures forever:

verses.text: Sihon king of the Amorites; for his loving kindness endures forever;
lines: Sihon king of the Amorites;
for his loving kindness endures forever;

verses.text: Og king of Bashan; for his loving kindness endures forever;
lines: Og king of Bashan;
for his loving kindness endures forever;

verses.text: and gave their land as an inheritance; for his loving kindness endures forever;
lines: and gave their land as an inheritance;
for his loving kindness endures forever;

verses.text: even a heritage to Israel his servant; for his loving kindness endures forever:
lines: even a heritage to Israel his servant;
for his loving kindness endures forever:

verses.text: who remembered us in our low estate; for his loving kindness endures forever;
lines: who remembered us in our low estate;
for his loving kindness endures forever;

verses.text: and has delivered us from our adversaries; for his loving kindness endures forever:
lines: and has delivered us from our adversaries;
for his loving kindness endures forever:

verses.text: who gives food to every creature; for his loving kindness endures forever.
lines: who gives food to every creature;
for his loving kindness endures forever.

verses.text: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven; for his loving kindness endures forever.
lines: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven;
for his loving kindness endures forever.
